rules.title: High CPU Usage Detected
rules.description: Total CPU usage exceeds 85%. This can degrade overall system responsiveness.
rules.recommendation: Identify and close non-essential high-CPU applications using 'adaptive-cli processes'.

rules.title: Elevated CPU Load
rules.description: CPU usage is above 70%. Heavy processing tasks are active.
rules.recommendation: Monitor process activity and avoid launching additional intensive operations.

rules.title: Critically High RAM Usage
rules.description: System memory utilization is over 90%. System may experience freezing or thrashing.
rules.recommendation: Close memory-heavy applications or browser tabs.

rules.title: High Memory Utilization
rules.recommendation: Review open applications and clear unused background services.

rules.title: Critical Low Disk Space
rules.description: Primary disk partition usage exceeds 90%. Low disk space can corrupt temporary files and slow down OS performance.
rules.recommendation: Clean system temporary files and empty package manager caches immediately.

rules.title: Low Free Disk Space
rules.recommendation: Scan for large files using 'adaptive-cli disk' and remove unneeded downloads.

rules.title: DNS Resolution Failed
rules.description: Unable to resolve internet domain names (e.g. google.com).
rules.recommendation: Flush the system DNS cache or check network DNS resolver settings.

rules.title: No Internet Connectivity
rules.description: Ping checks to public DNS servers (8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1) failed.
rules.recommendation: Check network cable/Wi-Fi connection or try restarting your network adapter.

rules.title: Large Accumulation of Temp Files
rules.description: Over 1 GB of temporary files detected on disk.
rules.recommendation: Safely clean system temporary files using 'adaptive-cli config --action clear-temp'.
